stem: A nurse witnesses repeated intimidating and threatening behavior toward a colleague. Which response best aligns with ANA's current workplace-violence position?

options.A: Use the organization's reporting mechanism and support a culture that investigates and addresses incidents
options.B: Ignore the behavior unless physical injury occurs
options.C: Discourage reporting because workplace conflict should remain informal
options.D: Post details publicly before using organizational safety processes

rationale: ANA's 2025 workplace-violence position calls for a culture of respect and safety, an organizational plan with a reporting mechanism for all incidents, staff training, multidisciplinary investigation, and guidance to support appropriate outcomes. Reporting should not be limited only to incidents that cause physical injury.
educational_objective: Respond to workplace violence or threatening behavior through established reporting and organizational safety processes.
source_claim_supported: Supports organizational reporting mechanisms, staff training, multidisciplinary investigation, and a culture of respect and safety.
correction_summary: Reframed the broad bystander item around the current ANA position statement and an explicit, supportable nursing action.
audit_findings: A aligns with the ANA position; B underreports, C suppresses safety reporting, and D bypasses appropriate processes.
blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11
